description: The fourth track's first persona, and the second real (non-spurious) foundation-first warning in this suite: 'Numerical Analysis IV' has a genuine hard RECOMMENDED_BEFORE edge from 'Numerical Analysis III' -- backed by that module's own `prerequisites` field explicitly stating Numerical Analysis III must be passed, not just recommended background. cp_by_area also exercises area=null modules correctly: Numerical Analysis III/IV are applied_courses (Mathematics faculty), not electives_informatik, so they contribute nothing to the Informatik-area CP tally -- only the three software_methods_tools/theoretical_cs modules do.
